function.name: vendor_billing_action
function.description: Unified vendor billing surface — sync a YAML vendor roster, snapshot status, list upcoming renewals, record manual payments, and (for vendors with an adapter) fetch live balance or trigger a live payment. TRIPLE-GATED on live payments (--apply AND --prod AND --confirm-amount must match) because money cannot be un-moved. Use when the user says "vendor status", "what bills are coming up", "record that I paid X", "pay X", "renewal check", or "vendor sync".

apply.description: Apply (sync DB / record payment / etc.); default is dry-run.

confirm_amount.description: Must match --amount exactly for live payments (third gate).
